events.title: A turning point for Haiti? New security force takes fight to powerful gangs
events.summary: Passengers look out of the back of a brightly-coloured shared pick-up style taxi, known locally in Haiti as a “tap tap” as it makes its way along the Boulevard du 15 Octobre in the east of the capital, Port-au-Prince.

events.title: UN officials call for urgent action in Yemen to push peace, reduce hunger
events.summary: Top UN officials called for bolstered efforts to stave off rising hunger and foster a path towards permanent peace in Yemen as they briefed the Security Council Tuesday morning.

events.title: ‘Some question if Ebola is real’: how trust is central in fighting DRC outbreak
